title: taco holders
text: taco holders. I purchased my first set on a special prime day deal and liked them so much I went back and purchased one more set so I have 8 in total now.  I washed them on the top rack of the dishwasher, no problem.  I will say the edges are slightly smoothed, but sharp too - because it is metal.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
